settings.definition_quote: Given are $K$ arms, where underlying each arm $j$ there is an irreducible Markov chain with state space $S_j$ and transition matrix $P_j$. For each state $s$ in $S_j$ there are mean rewards $r_j(s)$, which we assume to be bounded in $[0,1]$. ... We are interested in competing with the optimal policy $\pi^*$ which knows the mean rewards and transition matrices, yet observes as the learner only the current state of the chosen arm.

source.label: thm:regret
source.quote: Consider a restless bandit with $K$ aperiodic arms having state spaces~$S_j$, diameters $D_j$, and mixing times $\Tmix^j$ ($j=1,\ldots,K$). Then with probability at least $1-\delta$ the regret of Algorithm~\ref{alg:gen} ... after $T$ steps is upper bounded by ${\rm const} \cdot S \cdot \Tmix^{3/2} \cdot \prod_{j=1}^K(4D_j) \cdot \max_i \log (D_i) \cdot \log^{2} (T/\delta) \cdot \sqrt{T}$

results.notes: Unspecified constant 'const' recorded as O notation. Theorem number not printed in source; inferred from ordering (Theorem 1 is index-policy result). Regret is T rho* - sum r_t (random rewards).

conditions: all arms aperiodic irreducible Markov chains
learner knows number of states of each arm
tuning: run in rounds of length 2^i with confidence delta/2^i, guessing T_mix upper bound a(t) = log t

source.label: thm:regret
source.quote: Further, the dependence on $\Tmix$ can be eliminated to show that with probability at least $1-\delta$ the regret is bounded by ${O}\left(  S \cdot \prod_{j=1}^K(4D_j)\cdot \max_i \log (D_i) \cdot \log^{7/2} (T/\delta) \cdot \sqrt{T} \right).$

results.notes: Mixing time eliminated via doubling rounds; proof indicates T need not be known either (doubling trick), hence anytime. Section on unknown state space claims the same bounds without knowing state space sizes.

source.label: thm:aggsamples
source.quote: Then with probability at least $1-\delta$, after any $T$ steps colored \ucrl\ gives regret upper bounded by $42 D_\veps \sqrt{B C_U T \log(T/\delta)} + \veps (D_\veps+2) T$, where $C_{U}$ is the total number of colors for states in $\Psi_U$, and $D_\veps$ is the diameter of the aggregated $\veps$-structured MDP.
